note: Self-reported retail shares divided by one filer’s reported 13F shares. Not the filer’s vote, and not a percent of shares outstanding. Parent and sub-adviser rows are not added.

Schwab.rule: The only filing-manager name containing Schwab in this period is CHARLES SCHWAB INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT INC. That is the asset-manager 13F, not every share custodied at Schwab brokerage.

Fidelity.rule: No filing-manager name contains Fidelity. FMR LLC is the Fidelity parent’s 13F. Geode Capital Management is a separate filer and is not used.

Vanguard.rule: 10 filing-manager names contain Vanguard. This map uses the one with the most reported shares and does not add the others.

E*TRADE/Morgan Stanley.rule: No filing-manager name is E*TRADE. The broker label on this site is E*TRADE/Morgan Stanley, so the row is the exact name MORGAN STANLEY. JPMorgan is a different firm and is not used.

Merrill.rule: No filing-manager name contains Merrill Lynch. Merrill’s parent, BANK OF AMERICA CORP /DE/, is the 13F row. The percent is of that filer’s reported shares, not of Merrill brokerage accounts.

Robinhood.rule: No filing-manager name in this period contains Robinhood.

Webull.rule: No filing-manager name in this period contains Webull.

SoFi.rule: No filing-manager name in this period contains SoFi or Social Finance.

Public.rule: Pension funds with “Public” in the name are not the broker Public. No manager is named Public or Public.com.

Interactive Brokers.rule: No filing-manager name in this period contains Interactive Brokers or IBKR.
